trial_title: Efficacy of Chemotherapy, Associated to Either Cetuximab or Bevacizumab, in KRAS Wild-type Metastatic Colorectal Cancer Patients With Progressive Disease After Receiving First-line Treatment With Bevacizumab
brief_summary:
The main objective is to evaluate progression-free survival (PFS) at 4 months.

The secondary objectives are to evaluate the objective response rate (OR) (= complete responses (CR) and partial responses (PR)) according to the RECIST v1.1 criteria, the progression-free survival (PFS), the overall survival (OS), the overall survival from the date of the first-line chemotherapy used on the metastatic disease, the treatment tolerance (NCI CTC AE V4 criteria, except for peripheral neurological toxici

eligibility_table.criterion: Histologically or cytologically proven adenocarcinoma of the colon expressing non-mutated (wild-type) KRAS.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has metastatic colorectal cancer with KRAS wild-type status.

eligibility_table.criterion: Progressive metastatic disease after first-line treatment with chemotherapy alone: based on 5-FU (iv or per os) with irinotecan or oxaliplatin associated to bevacizumab.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not shown progressive disease after first-line treatment with chemotherapy alone, as he has received FOLFOX and FOLFIRI plus bevacizumab.

eligibility_table.criterion: Prior adjuvant chemotherapy (of the primary tumor) with fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin is allowed if the time interval between the end of this chemotherapy and the beginning of the first-line metastatic treatment is ≥ 6 months.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has received prior adjuvant chemotherapy with fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin, and the time interval is likely sufficient.

eligibility_table.criterion: Measurable disease (at least one measurable metastatic lesion) according to the RECIST V1.1 criteria (the lesion should not be located in a previous field of radiation).
eligibility_table.justification: The information about measurable disease according to RECIST V1.1 criteria is not provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have at least one measurable metastatic lesion according to the RECIST V1.1 criteria that is not located in a previous field of radiation?

eligibility_table.criterion: Previous radiotherapy is authorized if discontinued ≥ 15 days prior to randomization and if the measurable metastatic lesions are outside the radiation area.
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about previous radiotherapy and its timing.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient discontinued any prior radiotherapy at least 15 days before randomization?

eligibility_table.criterion: Sites of disease evaluated within 28 days prior to randomization with thoracic-abdominal-pelvic CT scan (or abdominal-pelvic MRI plus Chest Xray).
eligibility_table.justification: The information regarding the evaluation of disease sites within 28 days prior to randomization is not provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient undergone a thoracic-abdominal-pelvic CT scan or an abdominal-pelvic MRI plus Chest X-ray within the 28 days prior to randomization?

eligibility_table.criterion: Age ≥18 years
Patient with ECOG 0 or 1
eligibility_table.justification: ECOG 1.0 <= 1.0 → True

eligibility_table.criterion: Life Expectancy ≥ 3 months
eligibility_table.justification: Category not evaluable deterministically
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a documented life expectancy of ≥3 months based on clinical assessment and prognostic indicators?

eligibility_table.criterion: Hematologic function (polynuclear neutrophiles ≥ 1.5.109/L ; platelets ≥ 100.109/L ; hemoglobin ≥ 9 g/dL.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's hemoglobin level is above the required threshold of 9 g/dL.

eligibility_table.criterion: Known meningeal or brain metastases
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about the presence of meningeal or brain metastases.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have any known meningeal or brain metastases as confirmed by imaging studies within the last 3 months?

eligibility_table.criterion: Pre-treatment with anti-EGFR
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has no prior anti-EGFR therapy, which meets the exclusion criteria.

eligibility_table.criterion: Specific contraindication or known hypersensitivity to one treatment product
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided regarding specific contraindications or known hypersensitivity to treatment products.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have any documented history of hypersensitivity reactions to cetuximab or bevacizumab?

eligibility_table.criterion: Patient with known allergy or hypersensitivity to monoclonal antibodies (bevacizumab, cetuximab)
eligibility_table.justification: Patient's allergy status to monoclonal antibodies is not provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a documented allergy or hypersensitivity to monoclonal antibodies, specifically bevacizumab or cetuximab?

eligibility_table.criterion: Clinically significant affection of the coronaries or myocardial infarction within 6 months prior to inclusion.
eligibility_table.justification: No information on coronary health or myocardial infarction history is provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced any clinically significant affection of the coronaries or myocardial infarction within the last 6 months?

eligibility_table.criterion: Peripheral neuropathy of grade > 1 (CTCAE scale version 4.0).
eligibility_table.justification: No information on the presence or severity of peripheral neuropathy is provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced any symptoms of peripheral neuropathy that are graded >1 on the CTCAE scale version 4.0?

eligibility_table.criterion: Known depletion of the dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD).
eligibility_table.justification: No information on dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD) status is provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient been tested for dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD) deficiency, and if so, what were the results?

eligibility_table.criterion: Acute intestinal obstruction or sub-obstruction, history of inflammatory intestinal disease or extended resection of the small intestine. Presence of a colic prosthesis.
eligibility_table.justification: No information on intestinal obstruction, inflammatory disease, or colic prosthesis is provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a history of acute intestinal obstruction, inflammatory intestinal disease, or extended resection of the small intestine?

eligibility_table.criterion: Uncontrolled Arterial hypertension (systolic pressure > 150 mmHg and/or diastolic pressure > 100 mmHg with and without antihypertensive medication. Patients with high hypertension are eligible if antihypertensive medication lowers their arterial pressure to the level of acceptability specified by the inclusion criteria.
eligibility_table.justification: No information on blood pressure readings is provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's systolic blood pressure consistently ≤150 mmHg and diastolic blood pressure consistently ≤100 mmHg while on antihypertensive medication?

eligibility_table.criterion: History of hypertensive crisis or hypertensive encephalopathy
eligibility_table.justification: No information on history of hypertensive crisis or encephalopathy is provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced a hypertensive crisis or hypertensive encephalopathy in the past 12 months?

eligibility_table.criterion: Hepatic transaminases ≤ 2.5 times upper limit of normal (ULN) (≤ 5 ULN in case of hepatic metastases), alkaline phosphatases ≤ 2.5 ULN (≤ 5 ULN in case of hepatic metastases), total bilirubinemia ≤ 1.5 ULN
eligibility_table.justification: Lab values for hepatic transaminases and bilirubin are not provided, but no evidence suggests they exceed limits.

eligibility_table.criterion: Renal function (creatinemia ≤1.5 ULN; creatine clearance ≥ 50 mL/mn (Cockcroft and Gault) ; urine test strip < 2+. If proteinuria is ≥ +2 at inclusion, the serum urea test must be redone and show proteinuria ≤ 1 g/L within 24 h)
eligibility_table.justification: Creatinine level is 1.0 mg/dL, which is within acceptable limits for renal function.

eligibility_table.criterion: Completion of the EORTC QLQ-C30 quality of life form
eligibility_table.justification: Category not evaluable deterministically
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient completed the EORTC QLQ-C30 quality of life form with a score reported?

eligibility_table.criterion: Negative pregnancy test for women of child-bearing age
eligibility_table.justification: Category not evaluable deterministically
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient undergone a negative pregnancy test within the last 7 days?

eligibility_table.criterion: Information given to the patient and signed informed consent
eligibility_table.justification: Category not evaluable deterministically
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient been provided with a detailed explanation of the trial, including potential risks and benefits, and signed the informed consent form?

eligibility_table.criterion: Public Health insurance coverage
eligibility_table.justification: Category not evaluable deterministically
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have public health insurance coverage that includes reimbursement for chemotherapy combined with cetuximab or bevacizumab for KRAS wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer?

eligibility_table.criterion: Other concomitant malignancy or history cancer (except carcinoma in situ of the cervix, or non melanoma skin cancer, with curative intent treatment, when considered in complete remission for at least 5 years before randomization.
eligibility_table.justification: No information on other malignancies or cancer history is provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have any other concomitant malignancy or history of cancer, excluding carcinoma in situ of the cervix or non-melanoma skin cancer, within the last 5 years?

eligibility_table.criterion: Any treatment including an experimental drug, or participation in another clinical trial within 28 days preceding inclusion.
eligibility_table.justification: Category not evaluable deterministically
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient participated in any treatment including an experimental drug or another clinical trial within the 28 days preceding inclusion?

eligibility_table.criterion: Persons deprived of liberty or under guardianship.
eligibility_table.justification: Category not evaluable deterministically
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient currently incarcerated or under legal guardianship?

eligibility_table.criterion: Psychological, familial, sociological or geographical condition potentially hampering compliance with the study protocol and follow-up schedule.
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about the patient's psychological, familial, sociological, or geographical conditions that could affect compliance.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have any psychological, familial, sociological, or geographical conditions that would prevent them from attending at least 80% of scheduled study visits?
